## Author response to a public review round

- Round issue:
- Exact version and PDF SHA-256 addressed:
- Review report event IDs addressed:

## Point-by-point response

Reply to each material recommendation. Link a new version only after it is separately released and pinned. Do not rewrite prior review events or reports.

## Record event

Append one `kind: "response"` event to `reviews/record.json` with the exact same version, PDF SHA-256 and round issue URL; include the response report path and SHA-256. This response is an author assertion and does not replace reviewer judgment.
The record is append-only: never edit or remove prior review or response events.

## Checklist

- [ ] The addressed PDF SHA-256 is unchanged from the round's pinned version.
- [ ] The response is public and contains no restricted information.
- [ ] Prior reports and record events are unchanged.
- [ ] Any changed paper bytes will receive a new version and a new review round.
